## Overview

This vignette runs the core imprintomeR analysis on a plain beta table and a metadata table, without building an `ImprintomeSet`. It covers sample-level scores, per-ICR calls, uncertainty, and the plots that take tables directly.

Defaults to keep in mind:

- the genome build is **hg38** (`genome = "hg19"` for GRCh37 coordinates);
- the core `selected` panel is scored on **gametic ICRs** (`dmr_type = "gametic"`); `dmr_type = "all"` scores every probe;
- without controls, scores are relative to the fixed 0.5 reference; with controls (`reference_group`), they are centred on the controls.

The polar, radar, beeswarm and mirror-density plots are drawn by `plot()` on an `ImprintomeSet`; the last section shows the short route from the same tables.

## 1. Load data

The metadata table needs `Sample_Name` and `Sample_Group`. The beta table has one row per probe (first column: probe ID) and one column per sample, with beta values from QC-clean data.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(imprintomeR)

meta <- LoadMeta("meta.tsv")
beta <- LoadBeta("cleaned_beta.tsv")
```

## 2. Sample-level scores

`AnalyzeImprintStatus()` returns one row per sample: the paternal and maternal median deviations, the Imprinting Deviation Score (IDS), its direction (Angle), the sector label (Mechanism) and the status at the IDS cutoff.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
res <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(betaFile = beta, metaFile = meta, probeset = "selected", ids_cutoff = 0.2)
res[, c("Sample_Name", "Sample_Group", "n_paternal_probes", "n_maternal_probes", "IDS", "Angle", "Mechanism", "Status")]
```

Other selections and references use the same call:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
res_all <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "selected", dmr_type = "all")  # every probe
res_11p <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "chr11p15")                    # 11p15.5 locus panel
# With control samples in the cohort (Sample_Group "control"):
# res_ctrl <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "selected", reference_group = "control")
```

## 3. Uncertainty

`n_boot` adds bootstrap intervals for IDS and Angle and `Mechanism_support`, the fraction of replicates in the reported sector. Use at least 1,000 replicates for reporting.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
res_boot <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "selected", n_boot = 200, seed = 1)
res_boot[, c("Sample_Name", "IDS", "IDS_lower", "IDS_upper", "Mechanism", "Mechanism_support")]
```

With a control reference, `n_perm` adds a permutation test of the dependence on the annotated parental origin (`origin_perm_p`), and `CalibrateIDS()` derives an IDS cutoff from the controls:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# res_ctrl <- AnalyzeImprintStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "selected", reference_group = "control",
#                                  n_boot = 1000, n_perm = 1000, seed = 1)
# cal <- CalibrateIDS(res_ctrl, controls = "control", method = "quantile", probs = 0.99)
# attr(cal, "calibration")
```

## 4. Per-ICR calls

`AnalyzeICRStatus()` scores each imprinting control region on its own; `SummarizeICRStatus()` counts the altered ICRs per sample and flags multi-locus disturbance (MLID). The call thresholds (|deviation| ≥ 0.075 and |z| ≥ 3) assume control samples; without controls only the deviation criterion applies and the calls are exploratory.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
icr <- AnalyzeICRStatus(beta, meta, probeset = "selected")
head(icr[, c("Sample_Name", "ICR_name", "ORIGIN", "DMR_type", "deviation", "direction", "altered")])

icr_summary <- SummarizeICRStatus(icr)
icr_summary[, c("Sample_Name", "Sample_Group", "n_icrs", "n_altered", "n_gain", "n_loss", "MLID")]
```

Per-ICR calls cover all annotated ICRs, secondary DMRs included; `dmr_type = "gametic"` restricts them.

## 5. Heatmaps from tables

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Samples x ICRs, with a colour bar of each ICR's annotated parental origin
PlotICRHeatmap(icr, outFile = "icr_heatmap.pdf")

# Median beta per gene label of the panel, genes x samples
hm <- BetaHeatmapByGene(
  beta = beta,
  meta = meta,
  probeset = "selected",
  SAMPLEID = "Sample_Name",
  annoColumn = "Sample_Group",
  clusterRows = TRUE,
  clusterColumns = TRUE,
  outFile = "heatmap_by_gene.pdf"
)
```

`BetaHeatmapByGene()` takes the median of each gene label's probes, so one ICR can appear as several rows when its probes carry different gene labels; `PlotICRHeatmap()` shows one column per ICR.

## 6. Polar, radar and other plots

These plots are drawn by `plot()` on an `ImprintomeSet`, which can be built from the same tables:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
x <- ImprintomeSet(
  beta = beta,
  meta = meta,
  probeset = readRDS(system.file("extdata", "probesets_hg38.rds", package = "imprintomeR"))[["selected"]],
  genome = "hg38",
  assay = "450K"   # or "EPIC", "EPICv2"
)
x <- runImprintome(x, probeset = "selected")

plot(x, plot_type = "polar", probeset = "selected", outFile = "polar.pdf")
plot(x, plot_type = "radar", probeset = "selected", sample_id = meta$Sample_Name[1], outFile = "radar.pdf")
plot(x, plot_type = "beeswarm_origin", probeset = "selected", outFile = "beeswarm_origin.pdf")
```

See `vignette("imprintomeset-quickstart")` and `vignette("imprintomeset-results-export")` for the full set of plots and exports.
